race.comment: VENETIAN GEM (11) makes the most appeal among the debutants, with a recent third in a Lark Hill trial, William Pike booked and a strong female family headed by Listed winner Real Danger. Looks suited to the 1400m journey on debut and she can make a winning start to her career. LACEY MARIE (3) brings the best exposed recent form after consecutive thirds, the latest at this track when beaten two and a half lengths. Out to 1400m now, but CJP sticks and she should get every chance from the inside barrier. ENCROACHING (2) was sound enough first-up at Bunbury, where he covered ground and was beaten just under four lengths. Better for that run and better suited here. Can run an improved race. BRODA (6) debuts after winning a Lark Hill trial. Awkwardly drawn, though she can feature with a touch of luck. ANGEL CRAFT (10) is not to be discounted with some handy trials under her belt in readiness.
